title: CSAIL Primary Logo and MIT Schwarzman College of Computing Logo
slide_intent: Show which arrangements preserve the institutional relationship when the available space changes shape.
strategic_value: The lab can keep its primary signature distinct while presenting the college consistently in black.
demonstration: Four examples pair the college’s horizontal or vertical lockup with black, orange, yellow or gray lab artwork. The lab sits beside or below the college.
practical_value: Select a horizontal or vertical pairing for the format and check the order, color and legibility of both signatures.

content_islands.name: Placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the rules for choosing orientation and color at left. Add the referral to the college guidelines near the foot.

content_islands.name: Pairing examples
content_islands.spec: Divide the right panel into four horizontal bands. Show both side-by-side orders, a vertical college signature beside the lab, and the lab positioned below the college.
